asset.label: BC Ferry Commission: shield and wording (vector reconstruction)
asset.publisher: Office of the BC Ferries Commissioner
asset.sourceLocator: Rebuilt against the Commission's full-colour website logo (841 × 895 px), the file the gallery holds; the sun rays, sun disc and crown use the native curves of the Province's reverse emblem specimen G (corporate identity emblems guide, page 3)
asset.dateNote: The observation date and any upload-directory year are not a logo adoption date.
asset.notes: The provincial shield in full colour, with BRITISH COLUMBIA arched above and FERRY COMMISSION below in outlined capitals.
asset.fidelityNote: A vector reconstruction, not an original master: the colour fields, highlights, shadows and all 30 letters are redrawn against the website PNG (silhouette overlap 99.76 percent; mean colour difference 2.8 of 255), and the sun rays, sun disc and crown are the Province's own curves from its emblem guide. The lettering's typeface is not identified; the letters are outlines, not a font. Colours are the PNG's RGB values, not print specifications. A vector PDF of the same drawing is a download.
